Catacombs

This is where the final battle with the Joons' Curse is going to take place!

The battle with the Joon Curse

The hurried transformation that concealed At-Zako nearly destroyed his memory. Tka-Rik cannot safely repeat it, so hiding as Zak is no longer an answer. He offers another choice: flee again under his temporary protection, or confront the Curse on Gipath. At-Zako chooses to defend his life with Lu-a-Jalla. Tka-Rik supplies ancient Joon equipment and joins him in the catacombs for the final battle. Defeating the Curse completes the campaign. [1, 2, 3, 4]
